also.quote: it's not that I'm reviewing it in the old way where I care about like the totality of the code, but I'm looking for like red flags,
it's very rare that I will ship something without reviewing the code. I'll do that if it's something that users will not touch, if it's like analysis code, or if it's purely visual

signature.caption: starts half their work
signature.why: Our pick: a Slack button that turns a bug report into an agent thread with one click, and he says about half the team's work starts there.
signature.quote: It'll show up in our Slack, and we've got a ‘I'm feeling Pucky’ button and a ‘I'm feeling ultra Pucky’ button. And we click, and that kicks off a thread. And that is the start of about half of our work right now, and it has created this virtuous cycle.

archetype.why: Ideas and bugs fan out to Amp threads in orbs. He scans the results for red flags.

signature_quote.value: the principle here is the agent's time is cheap.
signature_quote.more: Your time is sacred. So make it do the work to help you verify.
